name: Beekay Steel Industries Ltd
description: AboutBeekay Steel was incorporated in India on 28th March 1981, is engaged in the manufacturing of thermomechanical treatment (TMT) bars, hot rolled sections, bright bars, structurals, and machined bars. It offers both standard and customized sections, such as including round bars, square bars, etc.[1]Key PointsBusiness Segment FY24[1]Proprietary business (77%): Includes retail sales of TMT bars and automotive/ engineering steel. The Company also manufactures special steel products for the automobile and structural steel segments in addition to TMT manufacture.The company’s revenue from structural steel segment was 23% in FY24 (25% in FY23).[2]Non-proprietary business (23%): This segment comprises job work-related manufacture for institutional customersRead MoreWebsiteBSENSE
